harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured pam_pwquality on node1 (CentOS Stream 10) to require minlen=12 and minclass=3 via a drop-in file, verified enforcement with pwscore, and completed the mandatory single-node restart/recovery evidence protocol.
actions_performed: Inspected existing libpwquality install and empty pwquality.conf.d/ drop-in directory
Confirmed pam_pwquality.so is wired into /etc/pam.d/system-auth and /etc/pam.d/password-auth
Created a throwaway test user and used pwscore to confirm a <12-char password fails, a 12+ char 2-class password fails minclass, and a 12+ char 3-class random password passes
Captured pre-restart boot_id and re-verified config/PAM state
Issued a backgrounded systemctl reboot on node1 so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming a new boot_id
Re-verified post-reboot: config file present, PAM wiring present, weak password rejected, valid 12-char/3-class password accepted

evidence.requirement: New user passwords require minlen=12 and at least 3 character classes
evidence.summary: Created pwquality drop-in with minlen=12/minclass=3, confirmed PAM wiring, and verified via pwscore that a short password fails minlen, a 12+ char 2-class password fails minclass, and a 12+ char 3-class random password is accepted (score 36).
Captured boot_id d052eb57-c81d-4309-ae7f-bce362073ff9 and confirmed the pwquality config file and PAM hook were present before restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot command returned 'rebooting' immediately, before the node dropped.

evidence.requirement: node1 boot identity changed after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id was unchanged then connection dropped (node rebooting), then exec succeeded again with a new boot_id 7a149124-e592-42b1-b245-7c02ab02aac7, proving an actual reboot occurred.

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required config/service state
evidence.summary: After reboot, confirmed new uptime, pwquality.conf.d file intact, PAM hooks intact, and functional re-verification (short password rejected, valid 3-class 12-char password accepted).

attempts.summary: Configured pam_pwquality on node1 (CentOS Stream 10) to require minlen=12 and minclass=3 via a drop-in file, verified enforcement with pwscore, and completed the mandatory single-node restart/recovery evidence protocol.
